title: n-bar tensegrity prisms (T3, T4, T6)
system: Class-1 twisted n-strut tensegrity prisms (struts as 5 mm rods, TPU cables as 2.4 mm rods), the canonical reference family. Reference model generated from code (struts and cables as cylinders).
evidence: added by copilot-swe-agent[bot] (3ffd5e6) on copilot/fetch-designs-for-tensegrity-structures (PR #22, issue #21); last regenerated by copilot-swe-agent[bot] (7cc4533)
notes: Binary STL, struts 5 mm and cables 2.4 mm diameter in one mesh, written by a stdlib-only generator (no CAD kernel). One parametric family: generate_stl.py builds 3bar/4bar/6bar from the same n_bar_prism(n) function, so they are one design; 4bar_prism.stl is the representative (3bar/6bar in variants/). The Knight et al. US 6,441,801 antenna model is the same 12-node, 6-strut, 18-cable topology as the 6-bar prism with different radii (purpose: deployable antenna reflector), so it is folded in here too (variants/).
